create_bbox_provider: create a BoundingBoxDataProvider from a scene directory with 3D bounding box CSV and object pose files
get_bboxes_at_timestamp: get 3D bounding box wireframe edges and metadata at a given timestamp from the provider
transform_bboxes_with_SE3: transform bounding boxes using an SE3 world reference frame before retrieving edges
generate_category_color: generate a distinct RGB color for a bounding box category based on its category UID
check_bbox_provider_valid: check if the bounding box data provider loaded scene files successfully and is valid
